channel.title: Mobikom | Insights & Technical Papers
channel.description: Technical monographs, web performance papers, and telecom historical archives from Mobikom Bulgaria.

item.title: The 512-Byte Web Principle
item.description: Why reducing network round-trips (RFC 6928), first-byte MIME sniffing, and volatile RAM execution represent the true foundation of sustainable web operations.

item.title: Computer Memory for Non-Specialists
item.description: Hardware engineering guide by Stoyan Stoyanov, MBA on CPU cache hierarchies (L1/L2/L3), DDR generations, dual-channel buses, and enterprise RAID arrays.

item.title: Sea Stars Monograph: Pomorie Lake Lye & Mineral Balneology
item.description: Scientific monograph on Black Sea mineral balneology, authentic hyper-concentrated Pomorie lye developed with the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences (BAS), and clean digital preservation.

item.title: Dobruja Media Group: From Print to Real-Time Streaming
item.description: Operational chronicle of autonomous Linux server clusters, Red5 real-time video streaming, and independent regional media publishing across North-East Bulgaria.

item.title: The Zero-Cookie Advertising Protocol
item.description: Contextual media syndication doctrine: eliminating invasive third-party ad-tech bloat through first-party native edge delivery and semantic targeting.

item.title: 1992 Telecom Heritage: The NMT-450 Retrospective
item.description: Historical dissertation documenting Bulgaria's first commercial mobile operator (RTC Mobikom), analog 450 MHz radio physics, Motorola pagers, and Mobika phonecards.
